Чебышёвский переход от пути P6 к циклу.name: Chebyshev Transition from P6 to a Cycle
Чебышёвский переход от пути P6 к циклу.description: The transformation 4L−L² retains edges 1–2 and 5–6 and adds 1–3, 2–4, 3–5, 4–6. The new cycle follows 1,2,4,6,5,3. In the original path basis, the spectrum changes from 0,2−√3,1,2,3,2+√3 to 0,1,3,4,3,1; the Greenian eigenvalues are 0,1,1/3,1/4,1/3,1.

Графы чебышёвской орбиты пути P6.name: Graphs in the Chebyshev Orbit of P6
Графы чебышёвской орбиты пути P6.description: Steps m=1..6 give P6, C6, P2 plus C4, two C3 cycles, a relabeled P6, and three edges of conductance 2. The numbers of components and zero modes are 1,1,2,2,1,3. Vertex labels are retained; edges are computed exactly.

Конус базиса P3 и его графы.name: The Cone of the P3 Basis and Its Graphs
Конус базиса P3 и его графы.description: The cone a≥0, 0≤b≤3a. Extreme rays: the unit path P3 with coordinates (1,3), and edge 1–3 with isolated vertex 2 at (2,0). The four marked points represent all simple graphs in the fixed basis. The complete graph K3 is at (3,3).

Обращение спектральных координат в базис.name: Inverting Spectral Coordinates in the P3 Basis
Обращение спектральных координат в базис.description: Left: the connected part of the cone a>0, 0<b≤3a; right: its image α>0, β≥α/3. The green sectors a/3≤b≤3a and α/3≤β≤3α correspond to both the Laplacian and Greenian satisfying graph sign conditions. The orange sector b<a/3 maps to β>3α, where the Greenian violates these signs. The example (4,1) maps to (1/4,1) and gives Gr13=1/24>0.

Изоспектральные графы и собственные напр.name: Cospectral Graphs and Eigendirections
Изоспектральные графы и собственные напр.description: Two nonisomorphic weighted graphs with spectrum 0,4,4,8. G1 is K4 with conductance 3 on edge 12 and 1 on every other edge; G2 is K2,2 with parts {1,2},{3,4} and all conductances 2. The eigenvalue-8 modes are z1=(1,-1,0,0)/sqrt(2) and z2=(1,1,-1,-1)/2. Blue denotes a positive component, orange a negative component, and gray zero. The E8 projectors differ, although their ranks and the Laplacian spectra agree.

Одинаковый спектр и разные резистенсы.name: The Same Spectrum and Different Resistances
Одинаковый спектр и разные резистенсы.description: For G1, resistance R12=1/4 comes entirely from mode 8; for G2, R12=1/2 comes entirely from eigenspace 4. For pair 13, the contributions of eigenspaces 4 and 8 are 3/8 and 1/16 in G1, and 1/4 and 1/8 in G2: totals 7/16 and 3/8. Both Kirchhoff indices are 5/2. All values use exact rational arithmetic.

Собственные моды пути P3.name: Eigenmodes of the Path P3
Собственные моды пути P3.description: Components of three orthonormal modes: (1,1,1)/√3, (1,0,-1)/√2, (1,-2,1)/√6. Multipliers for L: 0,1,3; for Gr: 0,1,1/3.

Дополнительные грейды пути P3.name: Complementary Grades of the Path P3
Дополнительные грейды пути P3.description: Four correspondences: e maps to A∨B∨/3; A to B∨/3; 3B to A∨; 3AB to e. Each coefficient is divided by 3, and each direction set is replaced by its complement.

Две метрики в базисе пути P3.name: Two Metrics in the P3 Basis
Две метрики в базисе пути P3.description: Ellipses a²+b²/3=1 and a²+3b²=1 in the coefficients of w=a u1+b u2; the circle a²+b²=1 is shown for comparison. The axes coincide; the coefficients along u2 are reciprocals.

Собственные моды пути P6.name: Eigenmodes of the Path P6
Собственные моды пути P6.description: All six coordinate-normalized modes of P6. Positive components are blue, negative components orange, and zeros gray. At right, the eigenvalues of L are 0, 2−√3, 1, 2, 3, 2+√3, and those of Gr are 0, 2+√3, 1, 1/2, 1/3, 2−√3.

Вещественные моды цикла C6.name: Real Modes of the Cycle C6
Вещественные моды цикла C6.description: A complete real basis of C6: the constant and alternating modes, and cosine-sine pairs of frequencies 1 and 2. Components are normalized and rounded to three decimal places. Each mode is labeled with its L and Gr multipliers.

Парные моды нечётного цикла C5.name: Paired Modes of the Odd Cycle C5
Парные моды нечётного цикла C5.description: Two pairs of nonzero modes of C5 with eigenvalues (5−√5)/2 and (5+√5)/2. Cosine and sine components are normalized and rounded to three decimal places. There is no separate alternating mode.

Спектральные вклады в резистенсы P6 и C6.name: Spectral Contributions to Resistances in P6 and C6
Спектральные вклады в резистенсы P6 и C6.description: P6: R16=(7+4√3)/3+1/3+(7−4√3)/3=5, R34=1/3+1/3+1/3=1. C6: R12=1/3+1/3+1/6=5/6; R13=1+1/3=4/3; R14=4/3+1/6=3/2. Segment heights represent the exact values; the panels use different scales.

Диагональная проекция и ближайший граф н.name: Diagonal Projection and the Nearest Graph on Four Vertices
Диагональная проекция и ближайший граф н.description: The original cycle 1–2–3–4–1 has unit conductances and an added edge 1–3 of conductance 5. Its matrix on H is [[10,−4,0],[−4,4,0],[0,0,4]]. In the diagonal projection, links 1–2 and 3–4 have coefficient −1/5. Projection onto the graph cone has diagonal (554,244,248)/57, conductances w14=w23=124/57, w13=184/57, w24=91/57, and w12=w34=0. Squared errors relative to the original operator are 32 and 1840/57.

Разные графы с одной спектральной проекц.name: Different Graphs with One Spectral Projection
Разные графы с одной спектральной проекц.description: The graphs at r=−4 and r=−2 share diagonal (10,4,4) and the same nearest point in the spectral cone. The first has spanning-tree coefficient 24, Kirchhoff index 10/3, R13=1/6, R24=1; the second has 36, 23/9, R13=1/5, R24=26/45. The right panel shows the verified functions R13=(2/5)(26+4r)/(40−r²) and R24=(2/5)(44−4r)/(40−r²) on [−4,−2/3].

Два базиса и общий проектор цикла C4.name: Two Bases and a Common Projector of C4
Два базиса и общий проектор цикла C4.description: Two bases of H2: (1,0,-1,0)/√2 and (0,1,0,-1)/√2; (1,1,-1,-1)/2 and (-1,1,1,-1)/2. Their sums of rank-one matrices give the same rank-two projector E2.

Грейды и дополнение направлений цикла C4.name: Grades and Complementary Directions of C4
Грейды и дополнение направлений цикла C4.description: Two 3-by-2 grids show the eigenspace contributions to M and D. Coordinates are k2=0,1,2 and k4=0,1. Taking the complement reflects both coordinates and divides the direct-form coefficient by 16.

Спектральные вклады в резистенсы цикла C.name: Spectral Contributions to Resistances in C4
Спектральные вклады в резистенсы цикла C.description: Adjacent-vertex resistance 3/4=1/2+1/4 and opposite-vertex resistance 1=1+0, decomposed over H2 and H4. The H2 contribution to R12 splits as 1/4+1/4 in the original basis and 0+1/2 after rotation.
